title: Rahu, Grace and Witness Mind
sub: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 26 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. Why Rahu beats us, the eclipse, the churning story, Rahu Kaal, witness mind, Rahu in houses 1 to 6, vastu and Q&A.
desc: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 26, Planet Rahu by Brajesh Gautam: Sun, Saturn and the shadow, eclipse, the churning, Rahu Kaal, houses 1 to 6, ancestors, Q&A, with video timestamps.
points: Joy makes us forget God, so Rahu beats us until we remember. Repent quickly, then stop repenting.
The Moon covers the Sun for 18 years of Rahu: no clarity, doubt, a jammed head.
In any churn abuse comes out first. Do not hurl it or hold it. Give it to a listener and the cosmos.
The Moon is the umbrella that lets the nectar pass. Serve your mother, offer water to Shiva if the chart allows.
Knowing what runs in your head is the seer's stance. False beliefs and hypnosis are also Rahu.
Keep ancestors' photos there, keep it clean, no gate.
Jail roti, loans and liquor offerings are his own views and are not endorsed here.
